thread:
alex.p: Hey team — trying to pull traces for model inference in eu-west (svc: model-serving/eu-west). Grafana returns 403 when I click the 'Model Traces' panel. Anyone know the right link or quick workaround? Need for a postmortem draft. @maria.g

infra-bot: FYI: grafana-prod rotation completed 2026-02-12 03:22 UTC — RBAC changes were applied to observability roles. If you lost view perms report here or ping eng-platform.

maria.g: @alex.p you probably hit the recent role rename — observability-viewer replaced observability-read. I can grant a temp role/token. Do you need full Loki query access or just dashboard read-only? :wave:

alex.p: read-only dashboard is enough, but Loki query snippet would help me pull the exact log lines for the postmortem.

maria.g: Quick links (corp VPN required): Dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/model-overview-eu
Loki example query to find KV cache issues: ```{app=\"model-serving\", region=\"eu-west\"} |= \"kvcache miss\" | json | line_format \"{{.ts}} {{.msg}}\"```
If the Grafana link 403s, try the proxy: https://devtools.internal/obs-proxy/grafana?target=/d/model-overview-eu — proxy exchanges your SSO and issues a short cookie (15m).

ben: Also grab traces from Jaeger for root cause: https://jaeger.redwood/svc/model-serving?service=model-serving-eu. If you don't have access I can export a trace bundle. For alerts, note p95 latency alert is still 2000ms; we should consider 1200ms for this model family in a follow-up.

alex.p: Thanks. Clicking the Grafana link returned 403 but the obs-proxy worked for me. Can you grant a temp role for 1h @maria.g so I don't need the proxy?

maria.g: Done — added alex.p to observability-viewer until 1978127056 (1h). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: role change logged: observability-viewer added for alex.p at 1978123523

alex.p: I can see the panels and traces now. Pulling screenshots + Loki exports for the postmortem. Really helpful, thanks everyone :pray:

maria.g: Short troubleshooting checklist to share in the runbook: 1) Verify corp VPN / SSO, 2) Try obs-proxy if immediate access needed, 3) Confirm group membership (obs-console or observability-viewer). I'll open a tiny RFC to standardize role names and update docs.

ben: If you want, I can also lower the p95 alert to 1200ms for the model-serving-eu canary for the next 48h while we finish the postmortem. Ping me in the RFC thread.
